spans.s: N. of the author of Rājataraṅgiṇī.
Dimu. form of कहोड. Small Kahoḍa; [[Mbh.]] on [[
The white lotus, कल्हारपद्मकुसुमानि मुहुर्विधुन्वन् [[Ṛs. 3. 15.]] धन्याः खलु वने बाताः कल्हाराः सुखशीतलाः.
n. A day of Brahmā (or one thousand Yugas).

a. 
__1 Dry, withered. 
__2 Mischievous. 
__3 Excessive, spacious, large. 
-लः 
__1 A cat. 
__2 A cock. 
__3 A crow. 
__4 A sound in general. 
-लम् 
__1 Indistinct speech. 
__2 A kind of musical instrument; गायन्तीभिः काहलं काहलाभिः [[Śi. 18. 54.]] 
-लम् ind. Very much, excessively; [[Śi. 18. 54.]] 
-ला A large drum (military). 
-ली A young woman. 
-लः, -ला, -लम् A horn.
N. of a caste whose duty is to carry people in palanquins.
